$comment: SEC-43 (SECURITY-AND-SUPPLY-CHAIN-STANDARD §6.6): every third-party script a page of this site may load. Held by tests/test_third_party_scripts.py, which checks every public page's <script src> and the one script assets/analytics.js injects at runtime against this list. archived_source_copies are publisher pages kept as evidence, not site pages; the standards check skips them for the reason given. A change to what the site loads, or to what a vendor receives, is an ADR (see docs/adr/0008-google-analytics-4-on-the-public-pages.md), not only a new digest.

archived_source_copies.reason: corpus/ holds publishers' pages (California statute pages from leginfo and a City of Woodland CEQA notice) archived byte for byte so every citation can be re-verified, and the immutable v1 public evidence export pins them by path and bytes. They are evidence, not pages of this site: no page links to them, and their scripts are the publishers' own.

scripts.purpose: Count page views on the public pages (ADR 0008).
scripts.loaded_by: assets/analytics.js, which appends this element to <head> at runtime. It is never in the served HTML.
scripts.loads_only_when: the page is served over HTTPS from chelseakr.github.io under /permit-bearings/, the browser sends neither Global Privacy Control nor Do Not Track, and the visitor has not used the footer opt-out.
